items.ruby-sword-3d-hand-render.note: CONFIRMED BROKEN: hotbar slot renders magenta/black checkerboard and the held item is a giant checkerboard cuboid (missing model). Client log: 'Unable to bake item model: sample:ruby_sword' — IllegalStateException 'Multiple atlases used in model, expected minecraft:textures/atlas/items.png, but also got minecraft:textures/atlas/blocks.png' (CuboidItemModelWrapper.validateAtlasUsage). Root cause: the pack compiler emits single-source atlas entries for custom-dir textures (sample:obsidian/axe) into atlases/blocks.json (blocks atlas), while item/-convention textures (sample:item/ruby) are gathered by vanilla's items atlas on 26.x — and 26.1.2 forbids one item model from spanning two atlases. Single-atlas models work (corpus gems are blocks-only and render); ANY model mixing the two conventions breaks. Fix direction: on the 26.x+ rungs route item-model sprite single-sources into atlases/items.json (or both atlases), keeping blocks.json for block-model sprites.
